Class ItemModelProviderBase

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.data.models.ModelProvider
org.moddingx.libx.datagen.provider.model.ItemModelProviderBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.data.DataProvider, net.neoforged.neoforge.client.extensions.IModelProviderExtension
public abstract class ItemModelProviderBase extends net.minecraft.client.data.models.ModelProvider
A base class for item model provider. An extending class should call the handheld(Item) and manualModel(Item) methods in setup().

    • setTranslucent

      protected void setTranslucent(boolean translucent)
      Sets whether the materials generated from here on are marked as translucent. Like the render type it replaces, this stays in effect until it is changed again, so it is typically set in setup() around the items that need it.

    • material

      protected net.minecraft.client.resources.model.sprite.Material material(net.minecraft.resources.Identifier texture)
      Creates a Material for the given texture. Every material this provider generates goes through here, so overriding this is the way to customize them beyond setTranslucent(boolean).
